title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Fraud Detection and Credit Decisions

questions.text: What does AI use to build a profile of a customer's normal routine for fraud detection?
options: The customer's unique daily spending habits (where they shop, time of day, amount)
questions.explanation: AI analyzes where, when, and how much a customer typically spends to establish normal behavior.

questions.text: True or false: You have the right to request a human review of an automated credit decision that affects your access to credit.
questions.explanation: Regulations grant the right to human review of automated credit decisions.
